name: Mád (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of red over blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Mád: a yellow shield with a figure of a saint holding a chalice and a sword, within a green wreath, above a scroll inscribed MÁD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Mád arms with wreath and scroll
